existing_inventory.internally_dead_external_policy: ATTEMPTED externally as ANALYSIS metrics: dead on the internal repository does not imply dead on a different corpus. They are NOT added to any frozen learned baseline model.

utility_definition.reuse: EXACT canonical ClustOpt utility from Stage 3B

fixed32.purpose: prevents metric-quality analysis being confounded by any method's search policy

multiplicity.family_membership_rule: the 'per-index vs modern comparator pool' family contains exactly the four primary comparators; dcsi_author_compat is excluded from every family

modern_comparators.diagnostic_variant_policy: a diagnostic variant never counts as a comparator, never enters a primary FDR family, and never appears in a headline claim; it is reported only in its predeclared sensitivity analysis (configs/dcsi_sensitivity_analysis_plan.json)
